snippet.title: "Unseen" - Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description: It’s an indie horror game where John, a forensic photographer, after an unexpected and exhausting shift, is forced to spend the night away from home. What seemed like a temporary rest soon begins to turn unsettling. Add to your whishlist on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4085250/Unseen/
